name: Global Leaderboards & Cloud Account Save Safety
greenMarker: Cloud Save, 2-Ad Hint Limit & No-Hint Safety Audit PASSED 100%
note: A backup that silently omits what it claims to save is worse than no backup, because the player trusts it and stops keeping their own copy. cloudSyncService once re-typed two of three storage keys wrong and reported success anyway.

mutations.name: the wallet key is re-typed as a literal instead of imported
mutations.why: This is the original defect verbatim. 'suidoku_wallet_state_v1' looks right in review; only the running app disagrees, and backup kept reporting success with the wallet missing from the payload.

mutations.name: achievements are read by a hand-written key
mutations.why: That key is 'sudoku_achievements_v1' — no 'i' — unlike every other key in the app. Anyone re-typing it from memory gets it wrong and reads nothing.

mutations.name: the backup payload loses its schema version
mutations.why: Without a version the restore side cannot tell an old payload from a new one, and a shape change silently corrupts whatever it reads back.

mutations.name: the two-ad hint limit per game is removed
mutations.why: The cap is the whole ad economy. Without it a player can watch ads until the puzzle solves itself, and the difficulty curve and the IQ metric both become meaningless.

mutations.name: hints become available in Time Attack
mutations.why: Speedrun records are only comparable if nobody had help. A hint button there quietly invalidates every leaderboard entry in that category.
